**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 00:03  
[USER] User wants to create a Twitter card image size in HTML.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The recommended size for a Twitter card image is 1200x628 pixels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To include the image in HTML, use the `<meta>` tag with `name` attribute set to `twitter:image`.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Example HTML code provided:  
```php
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://www.example.com/image.jpg">
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The `twitter:card` property is set to `summary_large_image`, which tells Twitter to display the image as a large summary card.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional `<meta>` tags are needed for title, description, and Twitter handle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] More information can be found in Twitter's documentation: <https://developer.twitter.com/en/docs/twitter-for-websites/cards/guides/getting-started>.  
[USER] User mentions using `og:graph` HTML on their page with `og:image` sized at 1200x628 pixels.  
[USER] User states that when tweeting a link to the page, the preview image defaults to 360x360 pixels.  
[USER] User asks if they need to add something to their code to ensure Twitter shows the link preview image at 1200x628 pixels.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the user needs to include `twitter:card` and `twitter:image` meta tags to ensure the correct image size is displayed.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Complete example provided:  
```php
<meta property="og:image" content="https://www.example.com/image.jpg" />
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://www.example.com/image.jpg">
```  
[USER] User confirms that the "twitter:image" can be the same image URL as the "og:image" and asks if 1200x628 pixels is the correct size for "twitter:image".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, 1200x628 pixels is the correct size for the `twitter:image` image on Twitter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The recommended aspect ratio for Twitter card images is 1.91:1.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The image should be served with the correct content type (e.g., `image/jpeg` or `image/png`) and the file size should be less than 5 MB.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] More information about these requirements can be found in Twitter's documentation: <
